desc: The LTT Tactical Shotgun and Midwest Industries have joined forced to bring you a custom 1301 package. They start with the Beretta 1301 Gen 3 Base with the LTT Trigger Job then add the Midwest Industries stock and MLOK handguard. Gen 3 1301's ship with the 2024 Beretta Pro Lifter and semi flat trigger, Beretta's ultra reliable 7 round tube and threaded Optima Choke System.
